sources.snippet: EmbeddingGemma-300M on CoreML Gemma 3 bidirectional encoder (google/embeddinggemma-300m, arXiv:2509.20354) that produces a 768-d unit-norm sentence embedding, Matryoshka-truncatable to 512 / 256 / 128.

sources.title: EmbeddingGemma model overview | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: EmbeddingGemma is a 308M parameter multilingual text embedding model based on Gemma 3. It is optimized for use in everyday devices, such as phones, laptops, and tablets. The model produces numerical representations of text to be used for downstream tasks like information retrieval, semantic similarity search, classification, and clustering.

sources.title: EmbeddingGemma model card | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: EmbeddingGemma is a 300M parameter, state-of-the-art for its size, open embedding model from Google, built from Gemma 3 (with T5Gemma initialization) and the same research and technology used to create Gemini models.
